drafted_from: tool:keep-every-elestio-firewall's own row (its words, input schema, invoke and wake) and do-work/keep-every-elestio-firewall.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep every Elestio computer's firewall equal to its computer row, every fifteen minutes." It switches on the tool's wake on the computer that holds your Elestio key, and each run closes whatever someone opened from the dashboard.
no_lists_because: It keeps no row: the rules are each computer row's runs.firewall, and each run's answer is its run record.
instructions: 1. Hold elestio-api-key (bound only to api.elest.io) and the connection to the database that keeps your computer rows in the vault of one computer.
2. Give each Elestio computer's row a runs.firewall: {provider: elestio, account_email, project_id, vm_id, rules}, keeping 22/tcp and 4242/udp open to everyone.
3. Run it once with apply false and read what it would open and close.
4. Switch on its wake keep-every-fifteen-minutes on that computer, with the connection's held name as the switch input.
5. Open a harmless port by hand and read the next run close it: closed names it.

worked_examples.title: Keep both Elestio computers' firewalls
worked_examples.ask: Keep my Elestio firewalls equal to my computer rows.
worked_examples.given: Two computer rows with runs.firewall at Elestio, one whose Tail Logs port someone opened from the dashboard.
